start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:tell-the-person with database <the name of my own account database>, title <what I read first> and body <the rest>."
no_lists_because: A notice is a row of the person's own database; this workflow keeps it there and names no list of its own.
instructions: 1. Name the database your account keeps its rows in.
2. Say "Run workflow:tell-the-person" with database, title and body; add kind, a key (so the same thing is told once) and a url when there is one.
3. The first run makes the devices and notices tables when they are absent; a run where they exist changes nothing.
4. Your devices read the notice with workflow:read-my-device-notices; read them all with workflow:read-my-notices.

worked_examples.title: Tell me a booking was cancelled
worked_examples.ask: Tell me Bo cancelled the Friday call.

input.title: Bo cancelled the Friday call
input.body: Their history is in your history list.

worked_examples.given: The notices table holds no notice under booking:101:cancelled.
worked_examples.hands_back: id told:1, kept true; said "Told the person: Bo cancelled the Friday call.". Told again under the same key: the same id, kept false.
